# Plan & Design Readiness Checklist: QANOW 질의응답 게시판

**Purpose**: spec.md, design.md, plan.md가 구현 착수(implementation start)를 허용할 만큼 요구사항 품질을 갖췄는지 검증 (문서화 자체의 완전성·명확성·일관성·측정가능성 검사, 구현 검증 아님)
**Created**: 2026-08-25
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) / [design.md](../design.md) / plan.md (미발견)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

> ⚠️ **선행 이슈**: `.specify/scripts/powershell/check-prerequisites.ps1` 실행 결과 `specs/001-qanow-qa/plan.md`가 존재하지 않습니다. 아래 "Process Sequencing" 카테고리는 이 공백을 CHK029로 명시적으로 다룹니다 — `/speckit-plan` 실행 전에는 이 체크리스트를 구현 착수 게이트로 완전히 통과시킬 수 없습니다.

## Requirement Completeness — User Roles & Data Scope

- [ ] CHK001 Are the three user roles (게스트/회원/관리자) and their permitted actions each enumerated in one place, without requiring the reader to cross-reference multiple FRs to reconstruct the full permission matrix? [Completeness, Spec §Key Entities, §FR-001-022]
- [ ] CHK002 Is the data-scope difference between "회원의 질문 목록(본인 것만)" and "관리자의 질문 목록(전체)" stated as an explicit query-level rule rather than only as a UI description? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007, §FR-013, §FR-021]
- [ ] CHK003 Does the spec define what happens to "본인 작성 질문" scoping when a question's author account is later removed or changed? [Gap, Edge Case]

## Answer-State Edit/Delete Rules

- [ ] CHK004 Are the modify/delete permission transitions (답변 전 vs 답변 후) defined symmetrically for both the member's question and the admin's own answer, not only for one side? [Completeness, Spec §FR-009-011, §FR-017-018]
- [ ] CHK005 Is the exact trigger moment for "답변이 작성된 후" defined (e.g., on save vs on next read) so the edit/delete lockout timing is unambiguous? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-011, §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK006 Does the spec define the required outcome when a member's edit submission and an admin's answer submission occur concurrently on the same question? [Gap, Exception Flow, Spec §Assumptions 동시성 제어]

## Unauthorized Access Handling

- [ ] CHK007 Are the distinct unauthorized scenarios (비로그인 접근, 타 회원 질문 수정, 답변 후 수정 시도, 타 관리자 답변 수정) each mapped to one specific response without overlapping or contradictory handling? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003, §FR-012, §FR-018, §FR-022, §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK008 Is the "401 또는 로그인 안내" requirement resolved to a single deterministic behavior rather than left as an either/or choice? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-022]
- [ ] CHK009 Does design.md define a concrete Unauthorized UI state (trigger, copy, visual treatment) that fully satisfies the toast requirements in spec §FR-026, rather than leaving the trigger unconnected? [Gap, Design §14]

## Input Length & Empty-Value Handling

- [ ] CHK010 Are title/content length boundaries (min/max, "공백 제거 후" trim rule) stated identically across spec.md and design.md, with no numeric mismatch between the two documents? [Consistency, Spec §FR-005, Design §12]
- [ ] CHK011 Is whitespace-only input handling defined identically for question title, question content, and admin answer, rather than only for one field? [Consistency, Spec §FR-005, §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK012 Is the client-side character-count warning threshold (e.g., 80%) traceable to a spec requirement, or does it exist only as an undocumented design.md implementation choice? [Traceability, Design §12/§14, Gap]

## Success Criteria Measurability

- [ ] CHK013 Are SC-001 through SC-010 each stated with an objective measurement method (sample size, tool, threshold) rather than a subjective judgment call? [Measurability, Spec §Success Criteria]
- [ ] CHK014 Is it clear which success criteria (e.g., SC-001's "3명 중 2명 이상") must pass before implementation starts versus which are post-launch validation only, so the readiness gate isn't ambiguous? [Clarity, Spec §SC-001, §SC-008-009]

## Out-of-Scope Clarity

- [ ] CHK015 Is the MVP-excluded feature list (첨부, 댓글, 검색, 페이지네이션, 소셜 로그인, 통계 대시보드) cross-checked against design.md to confirm none of the three confirmed screens reintroduces an excluded feature? [Consistency, Spec §Out of Scope, Design §4, §11]

## Design Documentation — Screen Information Structure

- [ ] CHK016 Are information-priority orders for all three screens (메인/리스트/상세) documented at the same level of specificity, rather than detailed for some screens and only implied for others? [Consistency, Design §3]
- [ ] CHK017 Is the navigation/link map between the three screens complete for every button/action referenced in design.md, with no destination left undefined? [Completeness, Design §5]

## Design Tokens → CSS Conversion Plan

- [ ] CHK018 Does any document (design.md or plan.md) define who/how design.md §15 token values (colors, radii, spacing) get converted into an actual CSS variable/theme file, or is this left unassigned? [Gap, Design §15, §18-19]
- [ ] CHK019 Is the discrepancy between design-brief.md's 4px-based spacing scale (§13) and design.md's ad-hoc rem values (§18) resolved into one authoritative scale before implementation, so there isn't two conflicting sources of truth? [Conflict, Design-brief §13, Design §18]

## Main Hero Visual Effects — Implementation Scope

- [ ] CHK020 Is the Grid Glow effect's status (explicitly marked "not implemented in confirmed prototype" in design.md §10) resolved into a decision to implement, defer, or drop, rather than left open? [Ambiguity, Design §10, Design-brief §15]
- [ ] CHK021 Are the performance budgets (FCP, Lighthouse score, 60fps) from design-brief §15 carried into design.md or plan.md as binding, owned acceptance criteria for the Aurora/Floating Card effects? [Traceability, Design-brief §15, Spec §SC-008]

## prefers-reduced-motion Coverage

- [ ] CHK022 Are prefers-reduced-motion requirements defined for every animated element identified in design.md (Aurora, Floating Card, Skeleton loading), with none left unaddressed? [Coverage, Design §22]
- [ ] CHK023 Is the reduced-motion fallback appearance specified concretely (not only "animation:none") for each effect, so an implementer does not need to guess the static state? [Clarity, Design §10, §22]

## Loading / Empty / Error / Unauthorized States

- [ ] CHK024 Are Loading/Empty/Error state requirements defined for the 질문 상세 screen, or only documented for the 리스트 screen as currently written? [Gap, Design §14]
- [ ] CHK025 Is the Unauthorized state requirement resolved beyond "toast style declared but trigger unconnected," with an explicit owner and trigger list, before implementation is considered ready to start? [Gap, Design §14]
- [ ] CHK026 Are retry/recovery requirements (e.g., "다시 시도" button behavior) for the Error state specified consistently with spec §FR-025? [Consistency, Spec §FR-025, Design §14]

## Member vs Admin UI Differences

- [ ] CHK027 Are all member-vs-admin UI differences listed in design-brief §8 fully reflected as explicit requirements in design.md, with no row silently dropped? [Consistency, Design-brief §8, Design §6]
- [ ] CHK028 Is the mechanism for determining the actual runtime role (real auth/session) documented as a plan-level requirement, clearly distinguished from the prototype's manual view-switcher control? [Clarity, Design §6, Gap]

## Process Sequencing — UI Mock → /design-sync → Supabase

- [ ] CHK029 Does a planning document define the ordered sequence "UI Mock 구현 완료 → `/design-sync` 실행 → Supabase 연동 시작"? [Gap — plan.md not found in `specs/001-qanow-qa/`]
- [ ] CHK030 Are the entry/exit criteria for "UI Mock 구현 완료" defined precisely enough (e.g., which files/screens must exist and match design.md) to know when `/design-sync` may be triggered? [Clarity, Gap]
- [ ] CHK031 Is it stated as a hard constraint (not merely an assumption) that Supabase schema/auth work must not begin before `/design-sync` completes, and is "완료" for `/design-sync` itself defined? [Ambiguity, Gap]
- [ ] CHK032 Are rework requirements defined for the case where `/design-sync` finds a mismatch between design.md and the actual UI mock, requiring correction before Supabase integration proceeds? [Gap, Exception Flow]

## Cross-Document Consistency & Traceability

- [ ] CHK033 Do spec.md, design-brief.md, and design.md use one consistent status-badge copy string set (e.g., "답변 대기 중" vs "답변 대기" vs "대기 중"), rather than interchangeable variants? [Consistency, Spec §User Story 4, Design §13]
- [ ] CHK034 Is there a requirement/acceptance-criteria ID scheme linking every design.md section back to a spec FR-ID, or do some sections (e.g., §10 Grid Glow, §21 accessibility gaps) lack any spec traceability? [Traceability, Gap]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- CHK029/030/031/032는 `plan.md`가 아직 생성되지 않아 원천적으로 `[ ]` 상태를 벗어날 수 없음 — `/speckit-plan` 실행 후 재평가 필요
- Add comments or findings inline
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference
